title: Pinned columns sit after Unassigned in the order they were pinned
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. four technicians, e.g. "Esther Howard", "Jenny Wilson", "Kristin Watson", "Ralph Edwards"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (one led by each and one with no lead):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose the customer "ZZAUTOTEST Pin Order" (add it with the Add button in the customer box if it does not exist; using it keeps this test's work orders apart from others at the location) and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
  6. Start with no pins and no saved technician order.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Pin Order so only this test's work orders show.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  5. Write down the column order.
  6. Click the pin control (tooltip "Pin column") on Ralph Edwards' header.
  7. Write down the column order.
  8. Pin Esther Howard.
  9. Write down the column order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each technician column header has a pin control.
  • After pinning Ralph Edwards his column is right after Unassigned, before every unpinned technician (read your four test technicians only, others may sit between the unpinned ones): Unassigned, Ralph Edwards, Esther Howard, Jenny Wilson, Kristin Watson.
  • After pinning Esther Howard: Unassigned, Ralph Edwards, Esther Howard, Jenny Wilson, Kristin Watson (the newest pin goes after the existing pin).
  • The design also shows a short message such as "Ralph Edwards pinned": optional, not part of the check.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S3-R7, S3-R15, S3-R16, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), Board "Pin column" control; on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R7: “Allow users to pin a technician from the column header.”
  • S3-R15: “Place pinned technicians after fixed Unassigned and before unpinned technicians.”
  • S3-R16: “Append each newly pinned technician after the existing pins.”
